title: SWITCH FRAMES W1 light, display film: Cmd-1..9 by real HID keys, filmed by CuaDriver's display recorder (~30 fps; fallback while the app's own recorder gives no frames)
why: Lawrence 2026-11-02: changing workspaces must change frame perfect, even with a ton of stuff. Each switch: the target's complete frame in the next refresh, no old frame after it, no blank or half-drawn frame, current terminal content, the sidebar selection in the same frame. The VM judge (scripts/cmux-next/switch-frames/judge_switch.py) reads the movie. Fallback film: content defects (old frame, half-drawn, blank, stale terminal, sidebar late) that last 2+ refreshes; not pacing evidence.

steps.title: set-up: the window at 70% x 70% of the screen
Cmd-1..9 in order, then a fixed seeded order
steps.name: sw-w1-light

steps.title: the last switch shows a beacon workspace: its beacon runs in the daemon, the app and on screen
